{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Claw}}
{{Image}}
A '''claw''' was a hardened piece of anatomy, usually found at the end of a limb on both [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] and non-sentient species. They could be used for a variety of purposes, including defense and digging.
